_readme: Real items are SLOTS. status 'placeholder' renders clearly labeled stand-ins. To replace: put the file in assets/, set file + source, status 'verified', then follow REPLACE.md. Never mark verified without the real file on disk. The user's own product photo and the real Veo 3.1 output are required.

product_photo.note: The user's real product photo (perfume or other). Must appear clearly.

gemini_rec.note: Real Gemini screen recording: choose Veo 3.1, upload photo, paste prompt. Hide account info.

veo_output.note: The real generated Veo 3.1 commercial. Needs user authorization and approved credits.
